This notebook reconstructs the condition-only community analysis present in the
original poster workflow and adds design-aware sensitivity analyses for the MAG
and high-quality vOTU communities. The experiment contains one membrane per
condition; consequently, every treatment coefficient is explicitly exploratory
and cannot separate treatment from membrane identity.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_community_differential_abundance.qmd [output-directory]
```

```{r}
#| label: community-differential-abundance
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

promote_file <- function(source, destination) {
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  incoming <- paste0(destination, ".incoming-", Sys.getpid())
  if (!file.copy(source, incoming, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE)) {
    abort("Failed to stage %s", basename(destination))
  }
  if (file.exists(destination)) unlink(destination)
  if (!file.rename(incoming, destination)) abort("Failed to promote %s", basename(destination))
}

extract_accession <- function(x) sub(".*(ERR[0-9]+).*", "\\1", x)

bray_curtis <- function(x) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  n <- nrow(x)
  answer <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(rownames(x), rownames(x)))
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) for (j in (i + 1L):n) {
    denominator <- sum(x[i, ] + x[j, ])
    value <- if (denominator > 0) sum(abs(x[i, ] - x[j, ])) / denominator else 0
    answer[i, j] <- answer[j, i] <- value
  }
  as.dist(answer)
}

partial_pseudo_f <- function(distance, reduced, full) {
  n <- attr(distance, "Size")
  delta <- as.matrix(distance)^2
  centering <- diag(n) - matrix(1 / n, n, n)
  gower <- -0.5 * centering %*% delta %*% centering
  projection <- function(x) x %*% qr.solve(crossprod(x), t(x))
  h_reduced <- projection(reduced)
  h_full <- projection(full)
  df_term <- qr(full)$rank - qr(reduced)$rank
  df_residual <- n - qr(full)$rank
  ss_term <- sum(diag((h_full - h_reduced) %*% gower))
  ss_residual <- sum(diag((diag(n) - h_full) %*% gower))
  c(F = (ss_term / df_term) / (ss_residual / df_residual),
    R2_partial = ss_term / (ss_term + ss_residual),
    df_term = df_term, df_residual = df_residual)
}

paired_permanova <- function(counts, metadata) {
  relative <- sweep(counts, 1L, rowSums(counts), "/")
  distance <- bray_curtis(relative)
  reduced <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle, metadata)
  full <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle + condition, metadata)
  observed <- partial_pseudo_f(distance, reduced, full)
  cells <- interaction(metadata$phase, metadata$cycle, drop = TRUE)
  if (any(table(cells) != 2L)) abort("Restricted permutations require two conditions per phase-cycle cell")
  cell_levels <- levels(cells)
  patterns <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(c(FALSE, TRUE)), length(cell_levels))))
  permuted_f <- apply(patterns, 1L, function(swaps) {
    permuted <- metadata
    for (k in seq_along(cell_levels)) {
      idx <- which(cells == cell_levels[[k]])
      if (swaps[[k]]) permuted$condition[idx] <- rev(permuted$condition[idx])
    }
    full_permuted <- model.matrix(~ phase + cycle + condition, permuted)
    partial_pseudo_f(distance, reduced, full_permuted)[["F"]]
  })
  c(observed, exact_p = mean(permuted_f >= observed[["F"]] - 1e-12),
    permutations = length(permuted_f))
}

matched_clr <- function(feature_counts, metadata, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  log_counts <- log(feature_counts + pseudocount)
  clr <- sweep(log_counts, 2L, colMeans(log_counts), "-")
  cells <- unique(metadata[, .(phase, cycle)])
  setorder(cells, cycle, phase)
  differences <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(i) {
    control <- metadata[phase == cells$phase[[i]] & cycle == cells$cycle[[i]] & condition == "control", sample_title]
    treatment <- metadata[phase == cells$phase[[i]] & cycle == cells$cycle[[i]] & condition == "treatment", sample_title]
    clr[, treatment] - clr[, control]
  }, numeric(nrow(feature_counts)))
  rownames(differences) <- rownames(feature_counts)
  patterns <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(c(-1, 1)), ncol(differences))))
  observed <- abs(rowMeans(differences))
  exact_p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(differences)), function(i) {
    permuted <- abs(as.vector(patterns %*% differences[i, ]) / ncol(differences))
    mean(permuted >= observed[[i]] - 1e-12)
  }, numeric(1))
  data.table(
    feature_id = rownames(differences),
    mean_clr_difference = rowMeans(differences),
    median_clr_difference = apply(differences, 1L, median),
    treatment_higher_cells = rowSums(differences > 0),
    control_higher_cells = rowSums(differences < 0),
    exact_signflip_p = exact_p,
    exact_signflip_fdr = p.adjust(exact_p, "BH"),
    matched_cells = ncol(differences),
    pseudocount = pseudocount
  )
}

run_deseq <- function(feature_counts, metadata, design, model_name) {
  rounded <- round(feature_counts)
  storage.mode(rounded) <- "integer"
  col_data <- as.data.frame(metadata[match(colnames(rounded), sample_title)])
  rownames(col_data) <- col_data$sample_title
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = rounded,
    colData = col_data,
    design = design
  )
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10L) >= 3L
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)
  result <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(
    results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "treatment", "control"), alpha = 0.05)
  ), keep.rownames = "feature_id")
  result[, absolute_log2_fold_change := abs(log2FoldChange)]
  setorder(result, padj, pvalue, -absolute_log2_fold_change, na.last = TRUE)
  result[, `:=`(
    model = model_name,
    tested = !is.na(pvalue),
    supported_fdr05 = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
    supported_fdr05_lfc1 = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1
  )]
  result
}

make_pcoa <- function(sample_counts, metadata, layer) {
  relative <- sweep(sample_counts, 1L, rowSums(sample_counts), "/")
  ordination <- cmdscale(bray_curtis(relative), k = 2L, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
  points <- data.table(
    sample_title = rownames(ordination$points),
    axis1 = ordination$points[, 1L], axis2 = ordination$points[, 2L],
    axis1_percent = 100 * ordination$eig[[1L]] / sum(ordination$eig[ordination$eig > 0]),
    axis2_percent = 100 * ordination$eig[[2L]] / sum(ordination$eig[ordination$eig > 0]),
    community = layer
  )
  merge(points, metadata, by = "sample_title", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
}

repo_root <- normalizePath(getwd())
if (!file.exists(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))) abort("Run from the repository root")
project_data <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
output_dir <- if (length(args)) normalizePath(args[[1L]], mustWork = FALSE) else
  file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance")
if (dir.exists(output_dir)) abort("Output directory already exists: %s", output_dir)
staging <- file.path(dirname(output_dir), sprintf(".community-da-staging-%d", Sys.getpid()))
dir.create(file.path(staging, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(staging, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
on.exit(if (dir.exists(staging)) unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

paths <- list(
  counts = file.path(project_data, "quantification", "mags_votu", "coverage", "metagenomics", "coverm", "output-Read_Count.tsv"),
  metadata = file.path(repo_root, "metadata", "sample_metadata.tsv"),
  mag_context = file.path(project_data, "derived", "manuscript_figure_candidates", "tables", "mag_taxonomic_context.tsv"),
  checkv = file.path(project_data, "viromics", "annotation", "PRJEB79569_vOTUs", "vclust_catalogue", "checkv", "quality_summary.tsv"),
  cenote = file.path(project_data, "viromics", "annotation", "PRJEB79569_vOTUs", "vclust_catalogue", "cenotetaker3", "output", "output_virus_summary.tsv")
)
missing <- names(paths)[!file.exists(unlist(paths))]
if (length(missing)) abort("Missing inputs: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

metadata <- fread(paths$metadata)[, .(sample_title, condition, phase, cycle, metagenome_run_accession)]
metadata[, `:=`(
  condition = factor(condition, levels = c("control", "treatment")),
  phase = factor(phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush")),
  cycle = factor(cycle, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
)]
setorder(metadata, cycle, phase, condition)

checkv <- fread(paths$checkv, select = c("contig_id", "viral_genes", "miuvig_quality"))
cenote <- fread(paths$cenote, select = c("input_name", "virus_seq_length", "taxonomy_hierarchy"))
setnames(cenote, "input_name", "contig_id")
votu <- merge(cenote, checkv, by = "contig_id", all.x = TRUE)
setorder(votu, contig_id, -virus_seq_length, taxonomy_hierarchy, na.last = TRUE)
votu <- votu[, .SD[1L], by = contig_id]
votu <- votu[miuvig_quality == "High-quality" & viral_genes > 0]
if (nrow(votu) != 616L) abort("Expected 616 high-quality vOTUs with viral genes, found %d", nrow(votu))

message("Reading current 12-sample CoverM count matrix...")
coverm <- fread(paths$counts)
count_columns <- setdiff(names(coverm), "Contig")
accessions <- extract_accession(count_columns)
if (!setequal(accessions, metadata$metagenome_run_accession)) abort("CoverM columns do not match 12-sample metadata")
setnames(coverm, count_columns, metadata$sample_title[match(accessions, metadata$metagenome_run_accession)])
sample_order <- metadata$sample_title

mag_rows <- coverm[grepl("_MAGScoT_", Contig, fixed = TRUE)]
mag_rows[, feature_id := vapply(strsplit(Contig, "_", fixed = TRUE), function(x) paste(x[1:4], collapse = "_"), character(1))]
mag <- mag_rows[, lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE), by = feature_id, .SDcols = sample_order]
if (nrow(mag) != 348L) abort("Expected 348 MAGs, found %d", nrow(mag))
mag_matrix <- as.matrix(mag[, ..sample_order]); rownames(mag_matrix) <- mag$feature_id

votu_counts <- coverm[Contig %chin% votu$contig_id]
if (nrow(votu_counts) != 616L) abort("CoverM matrix does not contain all 616 selected vOTUs")
votu_matrix <- as.matrix(votu_counts[, ..sample_order]); rownames(votu_matrix) <- votu_counts$Contig
rm(coverm, mag_rows, votu_counts); invisible(gc())

mag_condition <- run_deseq(mag_matrix, metadata, ~ condition, "poster_condition_only")
mag_adjusted <- run_deseq(mag_matrix, metadata, ~ phase + cycle + condition, "phase_cycle_adjusted")
votu_condition <- run_deseq(votu_matrix, metadata, ~ condition, "poster_condition_only")
votu_adjusted <- run_deseq(votu_matrix, metadata, ~ phase + cycle + condition, "phase_cycle_adjusted")
mag_clr <- matched_clr(mag_matrix, metadata)
votu_clr <- matched_clr(votu_matrix, metadata)

mag_context <- fread(paths$mag_context)
mag_annotation_columns <- intersect(c("MAG_ID", "phylum", "family", "genus", "species", "deepest_taxon"), names(mag_context))
mag_annotations <- unique(mag_context[, ..mag_annotation_columns])
setnames(mag_annotations, "MAG_ID", "feature_id")
votu_annotations <- votu[, .(
  feature_id = contig_id,
  taxonomy_hierarchy = fifelse(is.na(taxonomy_hierarchy) | !nzchar(taxonomy_hierarchy), "Unclassified", taxonomy_hierarchy)
)]
for (object_name in c("mag_condition", "mag_adjusted", "mag_clr")) {
  assign(object_name, merge(get(object_name), mag_annotations, by = "feature_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE))
}
for (object_name in c("votu_condition", "votu_adjusted", "votu_clr")) {
  assign(object_name, merge(get(object_name), votu_annotations, by = "feature_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE))
}

permanova <- rbindlist(list(
  as.list(paired_permanova(t(mag_matrix), metadata)) |> as.data.table() |> transform(community = "MAG"),
  as.list(paired_permanova(t(votu_matrix), metadata)) |> as.data.table() |> transform(community = "vOTU")
), fill = TRUE)
setcolorder(permanova, c("community", setdiff(names(permanova), "community")))
pcoa <- rbindlist(list(make_pcoa(t(mag_matrix), metadata, "MAG"), make_pcoa(t(votu_matrix), metadata, "vOTU")), fill = TRUE)

summary_table <- rbindlist(list(
  mag_condition[, .(community = "MAG", model = unique(model), features_tested = sum(tested), fdr05 = sum(supported_fdr05), fdr05_abs_lfc1 = sum(supported_fdr05_lfc1))],
  mag_adjusted[, .(community = "MAG", model = unique(model), features_tested = sum(tested), fdr05 = sum(supported_fdr05), fdr05_abs_lfc1 = sum(supported_fdr05_lfc1))],
  votu_condition[, .(community = "vOTU", model = unique(model), features_tested = sum(tested), fdr05 = sum(supported_fdr05), fdr05_abs_lfc1 = sum(supported_fdr05_lfc1))],
  votu_adjusted[, .(community = "vOTU", model = unique(model), features_tested = sum(tested), fdr05 = sum(supported_fdr05), fdr05_abs_lfc1 = sum(supported_fdr05_lfc1))]
))
summary_table[, boundary := "Exploratory: condition is confounded with membrane identity"]

for (entry in list(
  list(mag_condition, "mag_deseq2_condition_only.tsv"), list(mag_adjusted, "mag_deseq2_phase_cycle_adjusted.tsv"),
  list(mag_clr, "mag_matched_clr.tsv"), list(votu_condition, "votu_deseq2_condition_only.tsv"),
  list(votu_adjusted, "votu_deseq2_phase_cycle_adjusted.tsv"), list(votu_clr, "votu_matched_clr.tsv"),
  list(permanova, "community_restricted_permanova.tsv"), list(pcoa, "community_pcoa.tsv"),
  list(summary_table, "analysis_summary.tsv")
)) fwrite(entry[[1L]], file.path(staging, "tables", entry[[2L]]), sep = "\t")

source(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))
condition_colours <- c(control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]], treatment = phage_uv_condition_colours[["phage_uv"]])
p_ordination <- ggplot(pcoa, aes(axis1, axis2, colour = condition, shape = phase)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = interaction(condition, phase)), colour = "#C8C8C8", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) + facet_wrap(~ community, scales = "free") +
  geom_text(aes(label = cycle), size = 2.3, colour = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = condition_colours, labels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")) +
  labs(x = "PCoA axis 1", y = "PCoA axis 2", colour = NULL, shape = "Phase", tag = "A") +
  theme_phage_uv(9)

volcano_data <- rbindlist(list(
  mag_adjusted[, .(
    feature_id, log2FoldChange, padj, supported_fdr05_lfc1,
    label = fifelse(supported_fdr05_lfc1, fifelse(!is.na(family) & nzchar(family), family, feature_id), ""),
    community = "MAG"
  )],
  votu_adjusted[, .(
    feature_id, log2FoldChange, padj, supported_fdr05_lfc1,
    label = fifelse(supported_fdr05_lfc1, feature_id, ""), community = "vOTU"
  )]
))
volcano_data[, support := fifelse(supported_fdr05_lfc1, "FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1", "Not supported")]
p_da <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)), colour = support)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.72, size = 1.25) + facet_wrap(~ community, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 2.4, nudge_y = 0.04, check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1" = "#6A3D9A", "Not supported" = "#BDBDBD")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = 3, colour = "#777777") +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]("Phage-UV / control abundance")), y = expression(-log[10]("BH FDR")), colour = NULL, tag = "B") +
  theme_phage_uv(9)

figure <- p_ordination / p_da + plot_annotation(
  title = "Exploratory microbial and viral community differences",
  caption = paste(strwrap(paste(
    "Condition-only poster replication and phase/cycle-adjusted DESeq2 screens use repeated samples from one membrane per condition.",
    "They do not establish a replicated treatment effect; matched CLR and restricted-permutation results are provided in the source tables."
  ), width = 145), collapse = "\n"), tag_levels = NULL
)
ggsave(file.path(staging, "figures", "community-differential-abundance.pdf"), figure, width = 12, height = 9, device = grDevices::pdf)

writeLines(c(
  "# Community differential-abundance run", "",
  "- Reconstructs the original condition-only MAG DESeq2 analysis.",
  "- Adds phase/cycle-adjusted DESeq2 screens for 348 MAGs and 616 high-quality vOTUs with viral genes.",
  "- Adds six-cell matched CLR effect sizes and exhaustive 2^6 sign-flip tests.",
  "- Adds paired restricted-permutation Bray-Curtis pseudo-F tests.",
  "- All condition results are exploratory because one membrane represents each condition."
), file.path(staging, "README.md"))

files <- list.files(staging, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE]
checksums <- data.table(
  path = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(staging), "/"), "", normalizePath(files)),
  bytes = file.info(files)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))
)
fwrite(checksums, file.path(staging, "output_checksums.md5.tsv"), sep = "\t")
if (!file.rename(staging, output_dir)) abort("Failed to atomically promote output directory")
cat(sprintf("Community differential-abundance analysis written to %s\n", output_dir))
```
